criteria.description: Finalization resolves cancellation from canonical lifecycle state.
criteria.evidence: f753071f8; canonical one-read lifecycle and moving-tip provenance matrix in test_finalize_canceled_work_packages.py
criteria.notes: Pass when cancellation is derived once from the canonical event-backed status surface and secondary metadata cannot override it.

criteria.description: Canceled work packages are excluded from ownership validation.
criteria.evidence: 53ebfc3f4; normal and validate-only canceled ownership-less prompt controls plus eligible validation pairs
criteria.notes: Pass when canceled packages cannot trigger ownership presence, validity, overlap, path, surface, or audit-coverage failures while equivalent active packages still can.

criteria.description: Canceled work packages are excluded from execution-lane allocation.
criteria.evidence: 53ebfc3f4 and 85c9df87a; canceled nodes and canceled-only cycles are excluded while surviving active lanes remain
criteria.notes: Pass when first and repeated normal finalization omit canceled packages from every lane-derived surface and retain all eligible packages.

criteria.description: Active dependencies on canceled work packages fail before publication.
criteria.evidence: 53ebfc3f4; eligible-to-canceled direct-cut command tests reject before every writer
criteria.notes: Pass when every active-to-canceled direct dependency rejects finalization before lane-manifest writers run.

criteria.evidence: test_finalize_canceled_work_packages.py human and JSON stale diagnostics name both IDs and remove-or-repoint recovery
criteria.notes: Pass when human and JSON diagnostics name the dependent and canceled IDs and direct the operator to remove or repoint the edge.

criteria.description: All direct stale dependency pairs are reported deterministically.
criteria.evidence: test_finalize_canceled_work_packages.py multi-edge controls prove complete deterministic sorted stale-pair reporting
criteria.notes: Pass when one attempt reports the complete sorted set of direct active-to-canceled dependency pairs.

criteria.description: Canceled work-package history and definitions are preserved.
criteria.evidence: test_finalize_canceled_work_packages.py repeated finalization retains canceled prompts, tasks, and append-only events
criteria.notes: Pass when finalization leaves canceled prompts, task-outline entries, and append-only lifecycle events intact.

criteria.description: All-canceled missions finalize successfully with zero executable lanes.
criteria.evidence: 53ebfc3f4; normal and validate-only all-canceled tests, including canceled-only cycles, produce zero lanes
criteria.notes: Pass when normal and validate-only finalization return a valid deterministic zero-lane result without requiring a prior manifest.

criteria.description: Reopened work packages follow their current canonical state.
criteria.evidence: f753071f8; governed current-state reopen test and moving-tip provenance matrix preserve eligible reopening
criteria.notes: Pass when a governed canceled-to-planned transition restores the package to ownership checks and lane eligibility.

criteria.description: Missions without cancellations preserve existing behavior.
criteria.evidence: No-cancellation structural parity and #3431 cycle regression suites preserve eligible-cycle rejection; commit 53ebfc3f4 projects only canceled-only cycles out of executable graph validation
criteria.notes: Pass when no-cancellation ownership, grouping, dependencies, collapse-cycle checks, and reports remain structurally unchanged.
